name: codex-intelligence
description: Agentic codebase analysis for embedded C — PlantUML diagrams, call graphs, and intelligent autocomplete. Works with LM Studio, Ollama, vLLM, OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Azure OpenAI, Groq, Together AI, Mistral, DeepSeek, or any custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

commands.title: Codex: Show diagram for current file

enumDescriptions: LM Studio running locally — no API key needed
Ollama running locally — no API key needed
vLLM / llama.cpp / any self-hosted OpenAI-compatible server
OpenRouter — unified gateway to many cloud models
Manually configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint — set codex.llmBaseUrl
codex.llmProvider.description: Active LLM backend. Use 'Codex: Switch LLM provider' for a quick picker, or set this directly. Add more providers via codex.customProviders without an extension update.

codex.llmApiKey.markdownDescription: API key for the selected provider. Not needed for `lmstudio`, `ollama`, or self-hosted `vllm`/`custom` servers without auth. If blank, falls back to the provider's standard environment variable (e.g. `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `GEMINI_API_KEY`, `GROQ_API_KEY`, `TOGETHER_API_KEY`, `MISTRAL_API_KEY`, `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`, `AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY`), or the generic `CODEX_API_KEY`.

codex.llmBaseUrl.markdownDescription: Override the provider's default base URL. Required for `azure-openai` and `custom`. Also useful for a remote LM Studio / Ollama / vLLM instance (e.g. `http://192.168.1.50:1234`).

codex.llmModel.markdownDescription: Override the provider's default model. Leave blank for `lmstudio`/`ollama`/`vllm` to use whichever model is currently loaded on the server.

codex.llmDeployment.description: Azure OpenAI deployment name. Required when codex.llmProvider is 'azure-openai'.

codex.llmApiVersion.description: Azure OpenAI API version (only used when codex.llmProvider is 'azure-openai').

codex.customProviders.markdownDescription: Add your own OpenAI-compatible providers here so they appear in the `Codex: Switch LLM provider` picker alongside the built-ins — the way to support any other prominent (or brand new) agent/service without waiting for an extension update. Each entry: `{ "id": "my-provider", "displayName": "My Provider", "baseUrl": "https://api.example.com", "model": "some-model", "requiresKey": true, "envVar": "MY_PROVIDER_API_KEY" }`. See PROVIDERS.md for details.

id.description: Unique identifier — becomes the value of codex.llmProvider when selected.

displayName.description: Display name shown in the picker and status sidebar.

baseUrl.description: Base URL, e.g. https://api.example.com (no trailing /v1 needed).

model.description: Default model identifier. Leave blank for servers that use a pre-loaded model.

requiresKey.description: Whether this provider needs an API key.

envVar.description: Environment variable to read the key from if codex.llmApiKey is blank.

enumDescriptions: PlantUML (.puml) — richer syntax, needs the jebbs.plantuml extension + Java to render
Mermaid (.mmd) — renders natively in GitHub, GitLab, and VS Code markdown preview with no extra tooling
codex.diagramFormat.markdownDescription: Diagram syntax for all generated diagrams. `mermaid` renders directly in GitHub/GitLab and VS Code's built-in markdown preview with no extra install; `plantuml` supports richer notation but needs the PlantUML extension and Java. Run **Codex: Rebuild entire knowledge DB** after changing this to regenerate existing diagrams.

codex.vendorProfile.description: Active silicon vendor profile for path exclusion.

codex.cflowPath.description: Path to GNU cflow binary (Linux/Mac only — Windows uses built-in extractor).

codex.plantumlJar.description: Path to plantuml.jar for local PlantUML rendering.

codex.autoIndexOnSave.description: Re-index changed files automatically on save.

codex.maxFilesPerRun.description: Maximum number of files processed in one full rebuild.
